[SWS_DM_01268] Value of FaultDetectionCounter in case of monitor internal de-
bouncing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068
⌈
If monitor internal debouncing is used, The DM shall use the value returned after
calling the registered callback function
getFaultDetectionCounter
of the
ara::
diag::Monitor::Monitor
constructor as FDC.
⌋
7.3.4.1.5.4 Debounce algorithm reset
In some situations the application might want to reset the debouncing or to freeze
it. The DM provides the parameter
action
with value
kResetDebouncing
or
kFreezeDebouncing
for the method
ara::diag::Monitor::ReportMoni-
torAction
of class
ara::diag::Monitor
to provide some means of external con-
trol of the internal debounce counter.
